observations: Resume flow discovery: run.submitted must NOT drive status in the shared table — the resume worker appends run.submitted after the handler already set Runnable; a status write there would force every later run.starting through the historic Submitted->Starting replay shim and would have stranded the live reducer at Submitted.

The pre-existing server test injected_runnable_event_does_not_make_submitted_run_schedulable implicitly depended on the live reducer having no transition validation (injected run.starting flipped Submitted->Starting); its final assertion was updated to Submitted since the shared table now rejects that skip-runnable sequence (lib/apps/fabro-server/src/server/tests.rs).
